chatbot.welcome_message: Greetings! I am the Citizen Rights Assistant AI Bot. Ask me anything about complaint process, services, and SLA timelines.
chatbot.placeholder: Ask a question about citizen services...
chatbot.default_response: Regarding your query: As per Municipal Governance Regulations, an SMS with your tracking ticket number is dispatched immediately upon complaint submission.
chatbot.faq_sla: Standard SLA limits are 24 hours for water supply and drainage issues, 6-12 hours for power transformer issues, and 48 hours for street potholes.
chatbot.faq_voice: You can press the microphone button to record your complaint in your preferred language. Our AI system will automatically detect the department and priority.
chatbot.faq_escalate: If the SLA deadline expires, our system automatically escalates the ticket to the Supervisor, and directly to the Commissioner Dashboard if exceeded by 12 hours.
